title: Optimize ViewConfigPanel to align with Airtable property panel UX
body:
Restructures the right-side ViewConfigPanel from a flat form layout to an Airtable-style property panel with hierarchical navigation, collapsible sections, compact summary rows, and expanded appearance/user-action controls. ### Panel header - Breadcrumb hierarchy: `Page › List` / `Page › Kanban` etc., replacing generic "Configure View" title ### Collapsible sections - Data, Appearance, User Actions sections toggle via chevron with `aria-expanded` - Sort/Filter/Fields rows show compact summaries ("2 sorts", "5 visible") and expand inline editors on click ### Data section restructured - **Sort by** / **Filter by**: summary ConfigRows → expandable inline builders - **Group by**: universal field selector (auto-propagates to `kanban.groupByField`) - **Prefix field**: new field selector - **Fields**: summary with visible count → expandable column checkboxes - Type-specific fields (kanban/calendar/map/gallery/timeline/gantt) inlined here - Calendar gains `endDateField` support - Search/filter/sort enable toggles moved here from removed "User Filters" section ### Appearance section New fields matching Airtable: Color, Field text color, Row height (4 icon buttons as `role="radiogroup"`), Wrap headers, Show field descriptions, Collapse all by default ### User actions section New toggles: Edit records inline, Add/delete records inline, Click into record details. Existing Add record via form and Allow export consolidated here (removed standalone "Advanced" section). ### i18n 17 new keys added to all 11 locales (en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, ru, pt, ko). Missing keys (createView, typeOptions, etc.) backfilled for non-English locales. ### Tests 62 tests passing — 11 existing tests updated for new expandable sub-row pattern, 13 new tests covering breadcrumb, section collapse, appearance fields, user actions, calendar endDateField, and data sub-section toggle.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 优化列表视图右侧属性面板，对齐Airtable体验，支持多视图类型字段 > 参考 Airtable 列表视图的右侧属性面板（见截图），优化 ObjectUI 的 ViewConfigPanel： > > > > ## 优化要点 > - 层次结构分组，面板 header 显示 Page > List/Kanban/Gallery > - Data 区可动态展示 Sort by、Group by、Prefix field、Fields（见截图右侧Data部分） > - 支持多视图类型，如 Grid/Kanban/Calendar/Gallery/Timeline/Gantt/Map，切换时属性动态变化，例：Kanban 必须有 Group by，Calendar 必须有 Start Date/End Date > - Appearance 区可选：Color、Field text color、Row height（图标切换尺寸）、Wrap headers、Show field descriptions、Collapse all by default > - User actions 区可选：Edit records inline、Add/delete records inline、Click into record details > - 属性面板所有交互和字段都应贴近 Airtable，用于提升用户体验 > > ## 子任务建议 > - [ ] 引入 type-specific option 展现逻辑，所有视图类型字段动态显示 > - [ ] Data 区域属性基于视图类型变化 > - [ ] Appearance、User actions 区域优化交互与布局 > - [ ] 支持面板 header 上的层次结构导航 > - [ ] 支持属性折叠/展开，与Airtable类似 > - [ ] 支持面板字段国际化、图标与交互风格 > - [ ] 回归全部类型（Grid、Kanban、Calendar、Gallery、Timeline、Gantt、Map） > > --- > 如需设计稿请补充需求。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
